label: MN1::BEND2

sections.text: MN1 encodes a transcriptional regulator involved in developmental and hematopoietic programs.
BEND2 encodes a BEN-domain protein implicated in transcriptional regulation.

The fusion creates an abnormal MN1/BEND2 transcriptional regulator and drives tumor formation in experimental models. It is a recurrent driver in the CNS tumor group classified as astroblastoma, MN1-altered.
